jobs.bankSyncHint: Every 30 min. The manual sync in Reconciliation stays available at any time, whatever this is set to.
jobs.tendersHint: At 09:00 and 17:00. Worth stopping while SICAP blocks the IP; there is no point in trying for nothing.
jobs.bnrHint: Daily at 14:00. Invoicing in foreign currency falls back at read time anyway if a day is missing.
jobs.title: Operational crons

push.enabled: Push notifications are on for this device
push.disabled: Push notifications were switched off for this device
push.title: Push notifications
push.nativeNote: The native APK does not support web push notifications (it runs without a service worker, for cache reasons). Notifications work in the PWA from the browser (“Add to home screen”); the native version through FCM is to be added separately.
push.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
push.deniedHint: Permission refused at browser level. Switch it on by hand in the site settings, then reload the page.

android.title: Android app
android.hint: A native shell that updates on deploy: new content arrives when the app is reopened, with no reinstall. A reinstall is needed only when native plugins change.
